programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: Famous outlaw Jesse James convinces the James-Younger Gang to attempt its riskiest heist yet: a daring bank robbery in Northfield, Minnesota. But their well-laid plans are thwarted by sharp-eyed citizens intent on protecting their hard-earned money.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles

programme.title: The Tall Tales of Jim Bridger

programme.title: The Tall Tales of Jim Bridger
programme.desc: When a young girl is bitten by a rattlesnake, mountain man Jim Bridger finds himself in a race against time to save her arm and keep her alive as he desperately searches the wilderness for a medicinal plant that once saved the life of his friend.

programme.desc: Bart Maverick runs for senator in Silverdale after rescuing Reform Party candidate Ellsworth Greeley from an assassination attempt. Bart's campaign run becomes dangerous when his enemies intend to kill him if he wins, forcing him to throw the race.

programme.title: Cheyenne
